label: Q4 · 24 GB
title: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B with MTP
summary: The 35B mixture-of-experts model (3B active) in Unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL build with its built-in MTP head, on a 24 GB NVIDIA card. Two-token speculative decoding, 128K context and flash attention. Measured about 120 tok/s decode and 1,860 tok/s prefill.

tested_on.label: NVIDIA GPU with 24 GB VRAM (tested on an RTX 4090), 128 GB system memory
tested_on.notes: Thread pinning measured on an Intel Core i7-14700F: 16 threads on its P-core threads (0-15).

profile.description: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B UD-Q4_K_XL with MTP for a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU. Speculative decoding drafts 2 tokens from the built-in MTP head (4 overran the context in testing). 128K context, flash attention and 16 threads pinned to cores 0-15. Measured about 120 tok/s decode and 1,860 tok/s prefill. Uses nearly all VRAM, so it runs on its own.

variants.label: Q8 · 24 GB
variants.title: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B with MTP
variants.summary: The 35B mixture-of-experts model (3B active) in the 8-bit Q8_0 build with its built-in MTP head, on a 24 GB NVIDIA card. Higher quality than Q4, but --fit keeps a large share of the model in system memory, so it is much slower: about 54 tok/s decode and 540 tok/s prefill.

profile.description: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B Q8_0 with MTP for a 24 GB NVIDIA GPU. The 35 GB model does not fit in VRAM, so --fit places what fits on the GPU and keeps the rest in system memory. Speculative decoding drafts 2 tokens from the built-in MTP head. 128K context, flash attention and 16 threads pinned to cores 0-15. Measured about 54 tok/s decode and 540 tok/s prefill. Uses nearly all VRAM, so it runs on its own.
